summary: Ganymede is a self-hosted platform designed to capture and archive Twitch live streams and video-on-demand content. It saves the video data alongside a rendered version of the chat log associated with each archived session.
goodFor: It suits content archivists and regular viewers who want to preserve Twitch broadcasts locally for long-term storage and offline playback.
watchOut: You need to ensure adequate disk storage space for video files, and the software is strictly limited to Twitch rather than multi-platform streaming services.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker, so you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for media storage and put a reverse proxy in front for secure access.
